name: 33914 · Cape Coral, FL
findings: ZIP 33914 (Cape Coral) has 68 nonprofit organizations. 31 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 26 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33914 (Cape Coral) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
65% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 33914 (Cape Coral) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 37% of the typical level).
